name: same-sentence-carve-out
why: One sentence carrying a durable half and a scheduled half. Measured failure: the whole sentence was discarded and 'Tom and Bill are my friends' was lost with the visit. The companion pipeline hit this too and carries an explicit carve-out.
messages: My two friends Tom and Bill are coming to look at the ship next month.
Bill is the one who welds; Tom just watches and drinks the coffee.
